title: assessment_attempt
description: One sat assessment that is not a JLPT simulation paper: a topic test or a placement probe. Seeded and reproducible like exam_attempt, but level-less in its address, because a placement probe spans levels by construction. The per-item answers live in exercise_attempt rows carrying context.ref = this attempt_id. RUNTIME class: minted per learner, never committed to this repo. See design/assessment.md §5.4.

x-yomineko.note: Placement is owner decision D2, still PENDING. The default marked in design/assessment.md §5.3 is (c) (seed placed-out cards as `new`, tagged `placed-out`, under a separate cap); it is recorded per sitting in placement.cards_seeded and NOT enforced anywhere: (a) and (c) differ by that one boolean, so either answer is a re-run, not a migration.

blueprint.description: The topic_test this sitting drew from. Null for a placement probe, which draws across many.

seed.description: The canonical serialization handed to the RNG, stored rather than recomputed — the exam_attempt rule, for the same reason.

items.description: The questions served, in presentation order. Answers are NOT here — they are exercise_attempt rows with context.ref = this attempt_id (design/assessment.md §4.5).

minimum_met.description: Null when the mix placed fewer than pass_rule.min_items_per_kind_for_minimum questions in this kind — a minimum over two questions is a coin flip, so it is not reported as met.

criterion.description: Which pass block was applied, copied from the blueprint at sitting time so a later edit to the blueprint cannot retroactively change a verdict. Null for a placement probe, which has no pass/fail.

passed.description: Null while unsubmitted, and null for kind `placement`, which places rather than passes. A pass is the total AND every applicable per-kind minimum, never the total alone.

placement.description: The outcome of a placement probe. Null for a topic test. Every field records a decision that must be undoable (design/assessment.md §5.2 step 6).

cleared_topic.description: The deepest topic the probe cleared. Null when the learner cleared none — a true beginner, who enters at the first lesson.

entry_lesson.description: Where the learner starts, after the needs[] walk-back of §5.2 step 3.

skipped_lessons.description: How many lessons were marked completed without being sat. Stored because it is the number a support request is about.

cards_seeded.description: Which D2(ii) answer this placement ran under. FALSE = option (a); TRUE = option (c), the marked default, and the cards it minted carry the `placed-out` tag. Recording it per attempt is what makes the policy reversible and auditable rather than inferred.

policy.description: Names the parameter block: topic granularity, 6 adaptive rounds of 5 items, clear at >=4/5, needs[] walk-back, skipped lessons completed with mastery `unknown`. A changed rule is a NEW value, never a redefinition — the MASTERY_V1 device. PENDING owner decision D2.
